Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government digital identity systems and credentials. 30 variables in 5 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing a national digital identity system, including foundational ID systems that enable authentication across multiple services. Fully deployed means operational nationwide and accepting new registrations.
Comments: Congo-Brazzaville has a partially deployed digital ID system. The carte nationale d'identité informatisée et sécurisée (biometric national ID card) has been issued since Décret N° 2007-207 of 2 April 2007, with production exclusively in Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire. A feasibility study for a broader Système national d'identification digitale (SNID) was presented in June 2021. A national workshop on digital identity was held July 2025 under the PATN (World Bank-funded $100M project). A digital ID roadmap was drafted under PATN (World Bank ISR Jun 2025 notes roadmap 'not yet complete'). CIFEC (Système Intégré des Faits d'État Civil) validated in early 2026. Full nationwide digital ID not yet deployed.
